text.p: Odlewnie Polskie SA, a group of the seven Polish foundries fully owned by construction firm Exbud SA, expects to enter the Warsaw bourse in 1997, Odlewnie's president said on Wednesday.
"Our prospectus should be ready in June and we plan a bourse debut this year," Boguslaw Peczera told a news conference.
Peczera said Odlewnie wanted to use the raised funds to purchase more foundries but would give no other details.

Odlewnie has about seven percent of Poland's foundry market, estimated at 700,000-750,000 tonnes per year, and plans to increase output to about 100,000 tonnes in 1997 from the current 50,000, he said.

On Wednesday Odlewnie also said that for 3.3 million zlotys it bought 60 percent of Odlewnia Zeliwa Staporkow SA, which had been in Poland's National Investment Fund (NFI) mass privatisation programme.
